subject: PO + invoice header requirements / net terms negotiation
messages:
From: Laura Gomez <procurement@atlasfin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@atlasfin.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO and invoice requirements for Redwood deployment

Hi Vivek,

We're getting set to issue a PO for the Redwood pilot but need to confirm a few mandatory procurement fields so AP can process invoices against the PO automatically. Please confirm you can map these fields to Redwood invoices:

- Legal entity / remit-to name (exact as on PO)
- PO number (required on each invoice line)
- Invoice-to legal address and VAT / tax ID (we operate across entities)
- Contract reference (SOW ID or Redwood deal id)
- Line-level SKU or charge description (we need ledger mapping)

A couple of procurement constraints from our side:
- Standard net terms: Net 60 for new vendors (very hard requirement unless finance escalates)
- We issue invoices weekly for usage-based services but do a monthly settlement for payment runs
- PO must include our internal approval code (APPR-2026-11-ATLAS)

Can you send a sample invoice and confirm Redwood's vendor tax ID / remit details so we can populate the PO? If there's any credit or early-pay discount available that would help get an exception approved by our finance team.

Thanks,
Laura Gomez
Procurement Manager
Atlas Financial

Attachment: ATLAS_PO_789123.pdf (sample internal PO)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gomez <procurement@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoice requirements for Redwood deployment

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can support the fields you listed; below are immediate next steps and attachments:

- Attached: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW reference), PO_template_ATLAS.xlsx — sample invoice + mapping guide.
- Vendor remit and tax details: Redwood Inference, Inc. / 98-7654321 / remit@redwood.com (address on file in the SOW).
- PO number: required on every invoice line — we will surface PO on the invoice 'PO number' metadata field so your ERP can match.
- Weekly invoices: we can emit weekly usage invoices, and optionally produce a consolidated monthly statement for your AP run.

One note on terms: our standard is Net 30. For enterprise procurements we can consider Net 45 or a tailored cadence with credit approval. If Atlas requires Net 60 we will need finance sign-off and typically ask for a short approval window (or an early-pay discount structure).

Proposed quick path: can we do a 30-minute call with AP and your finance lead tomorrow to confirm PO header mapping and whether the Net 60 is a hard block? Vanessa and Kimberly are looped for billing / credit ops.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf, PO_template_ATLAS.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gomez <procurement@atlasfin.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoice requirements for Redwood deployment (billing details)

Hi Laura — Kimberly from Revenue Operations. A few clarifications so AP can map cleanly: 

1) Remit + tax: Confirmed - Redwood Inference, Inc. EIN 98-7654321. Remit email remit@redwood.com.
2) Invoice fields we will populate (and the corresponding fields in PO_template_ATLAS.xlsx):
   - "Invoice PO Number" -> PO number column on every invoice line
   - "Contract Reference" -> SOW ID / Deal ID (we'll include D-20261115-ATLAS-01)
   - "Charge SKU" -> friendly description + internal SKU tag in memo
3) Weekly invoices are supported — we'll mark each weekly invoice with week ending date and produce a consolidated monthly statement that your AP can consume for payment runs.

Regarding terms:
- Redwood standard Net 30. Escalated enterprise exceptions we can support Net 45 after a credit review. Net 60 is unusual for initial onboarding; Finance typically requires a purchase commitment or pre-bill cadence if Net 60 is requested. 
- Alternative: we can offer a 1% early-pay discount if Atlas pays within 15 days, which has helped other customers secure Net 60 operationally (they issue Net 60 but take the discount to accelerate payment).

If Net 60 is an immovable requirement, please have your finance lead confirm in writing and we'd route to our FP&A for final approval — timeline ~3 business days. Otherwise, Net 45 is a pragmatic middle ground we can pre-authorize for this pilot.

Let us know whether you want the early-pay discount encoded on invoices and whether AP needs any custom EDI/CSV columns.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (see PO_template_ATLAS.xlsx mapping tab)

From: Laura Gomez <procurement@atlasfin.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@atlasfin.com, CPO <cfo@atlasfin.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoice requirements for Redwood deployment

Thanks Kimberly / Vivek. A few internal constraints to flag: 
- Our corporate policy for new strategic vendors is Net 60 unless an early payment discount is available or the vendor accepts a pre-bill / milestone schedule.
- For this proof-of-concept we could accept Net 45 if there is an approved credit note from Redwood for the first 60 days, or if Redwood agrees to weekly invoices with a consolidated monthly remittance.

We are prepared to issue a PO this week if the following are confirmed:
- Redwood will accept PO field mapping per the template (confirmed)
- Redwood to include Deal ID on every invoice (please use D-20261115-ATLAS-01)
- Redwood provides a one-line summary of the early-pay discount mechanics so FP&A can approve the exception (if offered)

Sending a draft internal PO (attached). If you can return a revised SOW with the Deal ID and remit details in the header we will route for signature.

Regards,
Laura Gomez
Procurement Manager
Atlas Financial

Attachment: ATLAS_PO_789123.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gomez <procurement@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO and invoice requirements for Redwood deployment — proposed compromise

Hi Laura — appreciate the quick movement here. To get Atlas onboarded without delay, proposed compromise: 

- Terms: Redwood will agree to Net 45 for the first 90 days (no credit holdback required) conditional on receipt of signed PO with APPR-2026-11-ATLAS code.
- Weekly invoices: Redwood will emit weekly usage invoices; Redwood will also produce a consolidated monthly statement for your payment run.
- Early-pay discount: 1.0% discount if Atlas pays within 15 days of invoice date — we can encode this as an optional line item for AP to apply if they choose to take it.
- Invoice headers: please ensure PO includes: PO number, Legal entity, Remit-to name, VAT/Tax ID, and Approval code. We will map these to invoice fields exactly as Kimberly described.

Action items: I have started a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (link below). Once the SOW has the Deal ID and our remit info in the header we will countersign within 24 hours and our Billing team will expect the first weekly invoice the following Monday.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/contract/0XYZ

If your FP&A insists on Net 60, please loop your finance lead and we will submit a formal credit exception request, but that will add ~3 business days.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: DocuSign_SOW_Link.txt (contains DocuSign envelope url)

From: Laura Gomez <procurement@atlasfin.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@atlasfin.com, CPO <cfo@atlasfin.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO + invoice header requirements / net terms negotiation

Vanessa / team — we reviewed the proposed compromise with FP&A. Atlas will accept the Net 45 (first 90 days) + 1% early-pay discount option. Our AP will issue the PO this afternoon with the APPR-2026-11-ATLAS approval code and the VAT/tax id for the paying entity.

Please confirm you will: 
- Accept weekly invoices with the PO number on each line and include the Deal ID D-20261115-ATLAS-01 in the header
- Encode the 1% early-pay discount as an optional invoice-level line so our AP can take it if they pay within 15 days
- Provide a revised SOW with Redwood remit details in the header so I can attach it to the PO record (we need a final PDF for our vendor file)

Once we receive the revised SOW we will upload the signed PO to the vendor portal. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Laura Gomez
Procurement Manager
Atlas Financial

Attachment: ATLAS_PO_789123_signed.pdf
